neighbours.label: Onset of a gradual change that comes with time or practice (will begin to feel natural, starts to make sense, will get easier), not a scheduled or punctual beginning; promotes gradually/eventually
fire: Stick with the new keyboard layout and your fingers will start to find the keys on their own.
Once you have read a few hundred pages, the old spelling begins to look normal.
With enough repetitions the chord changes will become automatic.
Over the first winter the raw timber will begin to turn silver.
As the weeks pass the early mornings get easier to bear.
Keep writing a page a day and the words start to come without effort.
Given time, even the sharpest grief will begin to soften.
After a few seasons the vines will start to produce heavier crops.
quiet: Press the switch and the new keyboard layout will load on the screen.
Once you have read the first chapter, the quiz begins on the next page.
The chord chart starts on the second page of the booklet.
On the first morning the raw timber was delivered to the yard.
The weekly meeting begins at nine on Monday mornings.
She started writing the page at noon and finished before one.
The service will begin with a reading from the family.
After the harvest the vines are pruned back hard.

predictions: Habituation and slow-change sentences reach 0.2-0.65, peaking on the inchoative verb or the 'will' before it. 'Begin/start' for scheduled or punctual events (the concert will begin at eight, started the car) and stative twins stay under 0.05.
short: onset of gradual change over time
notes: Probe: 'the stretches will begin to feel natural' 0.621 (peak ' begin'), 'the sting of the rejection will fade' 0.337 (peak ' will'), 'the neighbours became friends' 0.247, 'the jargon starts to make sense' 0.238, 'Day by day the swelling began to go down' 0.142 (peak '.'); 'will begin at eight sharp' 0.006, 'started the car' 0.049, 'began with a reading' 0.009, stative 0.006. Card peaks ' will' x4, ' begin' x3, ' start' x3, ' began' x2, 'As time', 时间一长, 渐渐; the + pole's output suppresses gradually/eventually/slowly/soon/increasingly, so this pole predicts them.
